desc: Count frequencies of all 26 letters in the input string.
Implement the O(26 * maxFreq) 2-state DP over letters a..z for each f=1..max_freq (state = previous letter Deleted vs Kept-at-f), taking the min over all f.
Cross-check the DP against an independent brute-force reference on many small random strings; report mismatches (reported no mismatches over 10000+ cases).
Confirm the f-range bound (f <= max_freq) and that shifting never needs to exceed the immediate next letter's deficit (distance>=2 moves tie delete+insert).
